title: Castlevania Anniversary Collection
synopsis: Eight classic Castlevania games prepared by M2 for Konami’s 50th anniversary — retained as Limited Run Games’ #106 Nintendo Switch physical edition.

catalog.publisher: Konami · physical edition by Limited Run Games
catalog.mediumForm: Nintendo Switch game card · Limited Run Games edition

custody.physical: Nintendo Switch game card in retail case · Limited Run Games #106 edition

curatorNotes:
Castlevania Anniversary Collection gathers eight games from the series’ 8- and 16-bit years: Castlevania, Castlevania II: Simon’s Quest, Castlevania III: Dracula’s Curse, Super Castlevania IV, Castlevania: The Adventure, Castlevania II: Belmont’s Revenge, Castlevania: Bloodlines, and Kid Dracula, the last in its first official English release. It adds the eBook History of Castlevania – Book of the Crescent Moon.

Konami released it digitally on May 16, 2019, for its 50th anniversary, with emulation by M2. Limited Run Games produced the first physical Switch edition as Switch Limited Run #106.

This filing opens the Castlevania lineage on the shelf.
collectionNotes:
The retained object is Switch Limited Run #106, Limited Run Games’ standard physical edition of Castlevania Anniversary Collection.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Nintendo Switch; compatible Nintendo Switch family hardware
preservation.compatibility: Nintendo Switch software is region-free. The retained game card is the primary access copy and runs on any Nintendo Switch console.
preservation.concerns: Game cards are flash media; long-term charge retention, contact wear, and loss of the small card from its case are the principal risks. Any content delivered as an eShop download or update depends on Nintendo’s servers and is not preserved by the card alone.
preservation.knownRevisions: Released digitally on May 16, 2019 on PlayStation 4, Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, and PC. Limited Run Games issued the Switch physical edition (HAC-P-ATA9B) as Switch Limited Run #106 in standard, Classic, Bloodlines, and Ultimate editions.
preservation.availability: Limited Run Games’s physical edition was a limited production and now circulates through the secondary market. The digital Switch edition was issued separately on the Nintendo eShop.
